snippet.title: False Flag | Full Game, 100% Achievements
snippet.description:
Hey! 

This is a walkthrough for a game called 'False Flag'. I finished every rage-inducing level and unlocked all three Steam achievements on my way.

If you haven’t heard of False Flag, it’s a tricky 2D platformer. Your goal in most levels is to find a way to lose. Also, pet the dog!

False Flag is free on Steam. If it looks like a game you'd like to play, give it a try!

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4530790/False_Flag/

Really hope you enjoy. Thanks for stopping by!
